Copyright & License Notice
---------------------------

Copyright 2001, Regents of the University of Minnesota

MGridGen was written by Irene Moulitsas and George Karypis at the
University of Minnesota and is distributed as part of the ParMGridGen
package. The original distribution retains the copyright notice above
in each source file.

The serial MGridGen sources vendored here are a subset of the
ParMGridGen 1.0 distribution (MGridGen/Lib + IMlib), with a small
MSVC compatibility shim (IMlib/msvc_drand48.c) and an internal symbol
rename (errexit -> mgridgen_errexit) to avoid clashes with OpenFOAM.

Original package URL: http://www.cs.umn.edu/~moulitsa/software.html
